title: As the best historians relate, among the Celts
html_source: Medieval Latin historians did not delve too deeply into Celtic history, but this passage contains wording and content similar to some of the translations of Saxo Grammaticus and Adam of Bremen, who wrote histories on the Germanic tribes.
